description: Commission of Elections - Elected Mr. Thumbane Thribhuwana Keerthisinghe Dunuweera as a member of the Kandy Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kandy Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process triggered by a member ceasing to belong to their political party and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new elected member. The content is directly related to electoral processes for a local authority, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette.
